Golden canonical-signing fixture, authored by hand from the spec (PLAN 3.2; docs/getting-started.md '2 Sign every request'; docs/api/enrollment-spec.md 2.4): message = SHA256HEX(token) 
 METHOD 
 path 
 timestamp 
 nonce 
 SHA256HEX(body) — six lines in that order, joined by a single newline. The input `method` is deliberately lowercase to pin the uppercase rule. Digests are pinned (computed once at authoring).
